technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and multiple trend confirmations, but extreme overbought conditions across RSI/Stoch/Williams_R create elevated pullback risk; best suited for profit-taking or tight-stop entries rather than aggressive swing initiation.

fundamental.summary: AFL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 81 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; neutral market conditions with mixed congressional activity (small trades by junior member) and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (347), recent CPI event, and negative macro score (-6) create hostile trading environment; 81-day earnings horizon provides some buffer but insufficient to offset systemic risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + price above key moving averages + RSI 9 extreme overbought creates short-term momentum setup for quick swing profit if resistance at 57.10 breaks.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across all oscillators (RSI, Stoch, Williams_R), inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX, zero fundamental conviction, and no smart money alignment create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry despite technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows three white soldiers and price above key moving averages, but extreme overbought conditions across RSI/Stoch/Williams_R create unacceptable pullback risk at resistance.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (347), and zero fundamental/smart money conviction in hostile macro environment make this a high-probability mean reversion setup against the trade.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
